mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the mean return in low-unemployment periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.25 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers preemptive monetary tightening and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1250.0, or the average return in high-permit periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 108.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0, or the mean return in low-industrial periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand momentum, which increases inflation expectations and triggers a forward-looking equity market sell-off due to anticipated rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both RSAFS > 520000 and HOUST > 1250.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.0% per annum combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that inflation is becoming entrenched, prompting market expectations of prolonged restrictive policy, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 255.0 and FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals a labor market overheating, which accelerates wage growth and inflation, leading to a forward-looking equity market correction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 3.8% and PAYEMS > 151000.0, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized growth, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 257.0), signals a healthy economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, even in the face of moderate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL < 257.0, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
